text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In Tracen Academy's cafeteria, where
untold
battles take place day in and day
out...

text_block_list.name: Newbie Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
I'll be working here starting today! It's
nice to
meet you all!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, another rookie steps up to the
plate... Try
your best not to get cooked.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right at that moment, the cafeteria bell
rings!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What should I have today? I feel quite
hungry, so
maybe I'll get a little extra...

text_block_list.name: Newbie Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
(That warning earlier was a little harsh,
so I was
expecting the worst. But this
doesn't seem so
bad...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'll have a large omelet rice, some
Napolitan
spaghetti... and a carrot to
top it off.

text_block_list.name: Newbie Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
What?! You're going to eat all that by
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
If that shocks you, you're in for a real
surprise.
Here comes the Ruler of Japan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I'm starviiing. What should I eat
today? ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hm, the mapo tofu looks delicious, and
the pork cutlet bowl looks just as good...
Okay, I've made my mind up! It all looks
good, so I'll have
everything!

text_block_list.name: Newbie Staff Member
text_block_list.text: E-everything?!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Burn this moment into your mind. This is
the
power of the one who stands before
you—Ruler
Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grumble...

text_block_list.name: Newbie Staff Member
text_block_list.text: What was that sound?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Staff Member
text_block_list.text: She's here... She's coming!

text_block_list.name: Newbie Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Who's here?! Who's coming?!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Staff Member
text_block_list.text: The Beast... Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hrm... How embarrassing. I bet everyone
heard
my stomach just now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Anyway, what should I eat today?

text_block_list.name: Newbie Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Oh... It looks like she's having trouble
deciding.
That's better than ordering
everything off the
menu...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Staff Member
text_block_list.text: You don't get it, do you? The moment she decides what to eat is the moment that item goes off the menu.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm, I'm feeling like some hamburger
steak today.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Run, rookie! Get me the ground meat,
carrots, onions, and everything else that
dish calls for! Just bring anything we can
turn into a hamburger
steak!

text_block_list.name: Newbie Staff Member
text_block_list.text: R-roger that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the passage of time comes the
gentle lull of
the bell, signaling the end
of lunch.

text_block_list.name: Newbie Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... It's over... I didn't think it'd be this hard...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think, rookie? Gonna put in a
transfer
request?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The food today was delicious. See you
next time.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I can never get enough of
the food
here. It always tastes so great!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Thank you cooking for us. I'm
always
grateful.

text_block_list.name: Newbie Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
...I can do it!
I'll work hard to put a smile
on their
faces!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Then quit standing around and
help me
prep for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every day, these warriors of the kitchen
fight to
protect the smiles of the
students, and their
battle yet rages on!
